call_input.prompt:
Create one finished independent flat square 1:1 Korean online recruitment poster. The image itself is the complete poster artwork, edge to edge, no mockup, no photographed poster, no frame, no contact sheet, no multiple versions. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력. Use the maximum native resolution supported by the current tool and model for a square. Fully opaque background.

Art direction: a neighbor repair workshop is a chance to bring one small household object, inspect its condition, and decide what repair is possible. The text is the main visual construction: its grouped line lengths and open spacing let the participant compare what may be brought, what is excluded, and the actual scope of repair before applying. It must never visually promise successful repair or free parts. A compact, accurate image of a single small nonelectric folding tabletop mirror and a screwdriver inspecting its loose pivot screw supports that decision, rather than occupying the composition as a major scene. No people or communal workshop tableau. No before-and-after, no finished repaired object, no icons or assortment of tools.

Compose the top as a large two-line Korean title aligned left, with the recruitment subtitle directly below it and a small oblique overhead still-life illustration in the upper right. The visual shows the mirror's continuous frame, folding support, and one slightly loose metal pivot screw; a single flathead screwdriver tip is seated in the screw slot, visibly making contact. The support is not detached or floating. Use consistent daylight, a restrained small contact shadow, matte wood/painted frame, clear steel shaft, and subtle dark mirror reflection. The image is a precise small editorial illustration subordinate to the reading, not a photographic scene background, decorative icon, diagram, or collage. Do not cover any text with the object.

The main middle width belongs to four consecutive condition sentences: the invitation to bring an object, the exclusions directly adjacent to it, the provision of tools and parts cost, and the decision/non-guarantee sentence. Give these enough width to break naturally into complete Korean word groups and enough leading to remain readable at an actual 720px-wide screen view. The longest sentence must not be compressed into tiny type. Make the first invitation slightly heavier, then let the following sentences read as the true scope of the invitation. Do not put all conditions into fine print at the bottom. Below this body, arrange event date, session and entry times, place, and age/capacity in a compact but clearly readable attendance cluster. Photography consent and participation fee follow at the same usable body size. The application deadline plus full URL form a visually strong final action phrase, with a natural two-line break at the colon if needed, directly connected to the adjacent consent/payment and attendance information. The contact line is readable underneath. All copy stays entirely inside clean generous margins.

Typography and finish: bold broad Korean sans-serif title with controlled optical spacing, crisp human-readable Korean sans-serif body with slightly varied weight based on actual role, clean stable baseline for numerals and English URL. A cool pale blue-gray opaque ground, deep forest-black main lettering, and burnt orange only for the application phrase create strong reading contrast. Sparse, precise composition with no paper collage, no faux tape, no grid labels, no badges, no decorative characters, no fake microtype, no logos, no watermark, no invented text. Let actual sentence length and the small loose-joint inspection determine the shapes. Do not print any of these instructions.

The following are the ONLY fourteen displayed copy values. Render EACH exact value ONCE, preserving all spelling, spacing, case, numbers, punctuation, middle dots and the en dash. Natural visual line breaks between words within a value are allowed, but no wording changes, omissions, duplication, additions, new headings, translation, or abbreviated URL. The list order below is the source-copy list, not a required rigid one-column stacking template:
1. 고쳐 쓰는 토요일
2. 이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집
3. 2026년 12월 5일 토요일
4. 오후 2시–5시 · 입장은 오후 1시 40분부터
5. 하람시 잇는집 2층 · 수선길 12
6. 대상: 만 16세 이상 · 회차별 12명
7. 작은 생활용품 한 점을 가져와 주세요.
8. 전기·배터리 제품과 위험한 물건은 받지 않습니다.
9. 도구는 제공하며 부품 비용은 현장에서 안내합니다.
10. 수리 여부는 상태 확인 후 결정하며 완성을 보장하지 않습니다.
11. 촬영은 동의한 참여자에 한해 진행합니다.
12. 참가비 5,000원 · 현장 결제
13. 12월 2일까지 신청: haram-mend.example/join
14. 문의: 이웃 수리 운영팀

Do not print the list numbers, source-list labels, instructions, or any additional group headings. Distinguish the event date, entry time, session time, and application deadline clearly by context and typography. Render all fourteen values fully readable both in the native original and at 720px width. Keep the visual inspection cue small enough that the text's real conditions organize this square composition.

strengths: Central full-width condition sentences remain readily readable at 720px; the exclusion and parts-cost/non-guarantee statements stay immediately adjacent to the bringing invitation.
The orange deadline and complete URL are easy to find. Event date and entry/session times form a separate attendance grouping.
The small mirror, wooden support, metal pivot and screwdriver tip share a consistent perspective and contact shadow; no group repair scene or before/after promise appears.
uncertainties: The visible pivot screw and seated screwdriver tip suggest checking the joint, but the degree of looseness is not visually unambiguous.
Raster inspection confirms the visible dash, middle dots, colon, comma and URL glyphs; it cannot prove original Unicode code points.
Maximum supported native resolution was requested through prompt only and is not confirmed.
Physical function, repair effectiveness, authorship and print certification were not verified.
remaining_defects: The mirror looks intact and polished, so the intended loose-joint condition cue is weaker than the textual scope/decision cue.
Pre-call prompt.txt and actual call_input.prompt differ only by one terminal LF; exact call-input JSON is preserved.

ai_slop_observations.glyphs: No obviously malformed Hangul, fake microtype, duplicate copy, arbitrary logo, watermark or decorative character seen in native/720 views.
ai_slop_observations.structure_material_light: Wooden frame/support and steel screwdriver have differentiated surfaces and consistent soft shadows. The tool tip visibly touches the screw slot. Mirror reflection is blurred and generic; no real room fidelity is asserted.
ai_slop_observations.composition: Text hierarchy is coherent, with four wide conditions defining the central mass. Two horizontal and one vertical fine separator lines divide actual information roles; no extra group headings are present. The intact-object cue is a remaining limitation, not proof of physical repair.

unverified_scopes: Other slot or overall quantity, other direction's actual distinction, external reviewer judgments, physical usability or repair, print readiness.
